#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reject worker-authored changes to indexes generated after merge."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import subprocess
import sys


GENERATED_PATHS = ("docs/INDEX.md", "projects/INDEX.md")
MESSAGE = "generated file; automation regenerates it on main — revert your edit"


def git(*args: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    return subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args],
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=False,
    )


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--base", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--head", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    diff = git("diff", "--name-only", f"{args.base}...{args.head}", "--", *GENERATED_PATHS)
    if diff.returncode != 0:
        print(diff.stderr.strip() or "could not inspect generated index diff", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    violations: list[str] = []
    for path in (line for line in diff.stdout.splitlines() if line):
        subjects = git("log", "--format=%s", f"{args.base}..{args.head}", "--", path)
        if subjects.returncode != 0:
            print(
                subjects.stderr.strip() or f"could not inspect commits for {path}", file=sys.stderr
            )
            return 2
        if not subjects.stdout.splitlines() or any(
            not subject.startswith("[system]") for subject in subjects.stdout.splitlines()
        ):
            violations.append(path)

    if violations:
        for path in violations:
            print(f"{path}: {MESSAGE}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
